CheckTitle: EC2 instances with open ingress Redis port to the internet
Description: EC2 instances found to allow ingress from the internet to Redis port (TCP: 6379).
Risk: This port handles Redis in-memory data store operations. Attackers can dump all cached keys/values, execute arbitrary Lua scripts on the server, or overwrite critical configuration files via Redis persistence features.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure access to ports from the internet is limited for EC2 instances. Apply the concept of Least Privilege and limit traffic to sensitive resources.
